definitions.explanation: To remove hair from the face or body using a razor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剃|そ}る。
examples.english: I shave my beard every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{剃|そ}って⟦{坊主|ぼうず}→坊主：10119_bouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I shaved my head and went bald.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦かみそり→かみそり：10120_kamisori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{剃|そ}る。
examples.english: I shave with an electric razor.

notes:
{剃|そ}る means to shave hair off using a razor.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: ひげを{剃|そ}る

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ひげを{剃|そ}る: to shave one's beard
- {頭|あたま}を{剃|そ}る: to shave one's head
- {剃|そ}り{残|のこ}し: missed spot when shaving

RELATED WORDS:
- かみそり: razor
- {電気|でんき}かみそり: electric shaver
- ひげ{剃|そ}り: shaving, razor

NOTE: This verb is pronounced そる. Don't confuse with {反|そ}る (to bend/warp) which has the same reading.
